ACCT-01.title: UAC: Admin Approval Mode for administrators
ACCT-01.description: All administrators run in Admin Approval Mode.
ACCT-01.fixHint: Control Panel > User Accounts > set UAC to Default or higher.

ACCT-02.title: UAC: Secure desktop prompt for admins
ACCT-02.description: Consent prompt on the secure desktop (behavior 2 = prompt for consent).
ACCT-02.fixHint: GPO: Computer Configuration > Windows Settings > Security Settings > Local Policies > Security Options.

ACCT-03.title: UAC: Enforce Secure Desktop
ACCT-03.description: Show the UAC prompt on the secure desktop.
ACCT-03.fixHint: Security Options > UAC: only elevate UIAccess applications / Secure Desktop.

ACCT-04.title: Blank passwords for console logon only
ACCT-04.description: Accounts with blank passwords may only log on locally.
ACCT-04.fixHint: Default is 1 (enabled). If 0: correct via GPO/registry.

ACCT-05.title: Guest account disabled
ACCT-05.description: The built-in guest account must be disabled.
ACCT-05.fixHint: lusrmgr.msc > Users > Guest > Account is disabled.

DEF-01.title: Defender real-time protection on
DEF-01.description: Real-time protection must be turned on.
DEF-01.fixHint: Windows Security > Virus & threat protection > turn on real-time protection.

DEF-02.title: Defender Tamper Protection on
DEF-02.description: Tamper protection prevents malware from turning Defender off.
DEF-02.fixHint: Windows Security > Virus & threat protection > Settings > Tamper Protection. Possibly Intune/GPO.

DEF-04.title: Defender signatures current (< 7 days)
DEF-04.description: Antimalware signatures must not be older than 7 days.

DEF-05.title: ASR rule: block Office macros
DEF-05.description: At minimum, the ASR rule against Office macro malware should be enforced (GUID 75668c1f).
DEF-05.fixHint: GPO/Intune: configure ASR rules (Block mode instead of Audit).

DEF-06.title: Behavior monitoring on
DEF-06.fixHint: Check Defender policy; a third-party AV may have replaced Defender (then N/A).

ENC-01.title: BitLocker OS drive encrypted
ENC-01.description: The OS volume should be fully encrypted.
ENC-01.fixHint: manage-bde -on C: or Settings > Privacy & security > Device encryption. Requires Pro/Enterprise.

ENC-02.title: TPM ready and enabled
ENC-02.description: TPM 2.0 is required for BitLocker + Secure Boot + Credential Guard. Not applicable without a TPM chip.
ENC-02.fixHint: UEFI: enable TPM/Security Device; check tpm.msc. Not applicable without a TPM chip (e.g. VM).

ENC-03.title: WDigest authentication disabled
ENC-03.description: Prevents plaintext credential storage in LSASS (off by default since 8.1).
ENC-03.fixHint: Set UseLogonCredential=0 (DWORD). A missing value = secure default. Requires restart.
ENC-03.note: WDigest has been off by default since 8.1 and the setting is deprecated.

ENC-04.title: LSA protection (PPL) enabled
ENC-04.description: LSASS runs as a Protected Process Light.
ENC-04.fixHint: RunAsPPL=1 (DWORD) + restart. Verify on older hardware if needed.

ENC-05.title: Kernel DMA protection available
ENC-05.description: Protection against DMA attacks via Thunderbolt/PCI (effective status from DeviceGuard).
ENC-05.fixHint: msinfo32 > Kernel DMA Protection = On. UEFI: enable VT-d / IOMMU (3 = DMA protection available).

NET-01.title: Firewall Domain profile on
NET-01.description: Windows Defender Firewall for domain networks.
NET-01.fixHint: GPO: enable the firewall for all profiles.

NET-02.title: Firewall Private profile on
NET-02.description: Windows Defender Firewall for private networks.

NET-03.title: Firewall Public profile on
NET-03.description: Windows Defender Firewall for public networks.

NET-04.title: SMBv1 disabled
NET-04.description: The outdated, insecure SMBv1 protocol must be off.
NET-04.fixHint: Optional features > remove SMB 1.0/CIFS. If the component is gone entirely (possible as of 26H2), the check counts as passed.
NET-04.note: On 26H2 the SMB1 component may be removed entirely (then counts as passed).

NET-05.title: SMB signing required (workstation)
NET-05.fixHint: GPO: Microsoft network (client): Digitally sign communications (always).

BOOT-01.title: Secure Boot enabled
BOOT-01.description: UEFI Secure Boot prevents boot malware.
BOOT-01.fixHint: UEFI: enable Secure Boot. On VMs check Hyper-V settings if needed. Not applicable in VMs without Secure Boot support.

BOOT-02.title: Virtualization Based Security (VBS) active
BOOT-02.description: VBS isolates security-critical processes (effective status, not just policy).
BOOT-02.fixHint: GPO: Device Guard > Turn on virtualization-based security (status 2 = enabled and running). Requires UEFI + virtualization support.

BOOT-03.title: Memory integrity (HVCI) enforced
BOOT-03.description: Hypervisor-protected code integrity against driver malware (effective status).
BOOT-03.fixHint: Windows Security > Device security > Core isolation > turn on Memory integrity (2 = enforced).

BOOT-04.title: Credential Guard running
BOOT-04.description: Isolates LSASS secrets via virtualization (effective status). Requires Enterprise/Education.
BOOT-04.fixHint: Requires Windows Enterprise/Education + UEFI + TPM + VBS. Not applicable on other editions (counted as N/A).

UPD-01.title: Windows Update service not disabled
UPD-01.description: The update service must not be disabled.
UPD-01.fixHint: services.msc > Windows Update > Startup type Automatic or Manual (not Disabled).

UPD-02.title: No NoAutoUpdate policy block
UPD-02.description: If an AU policy exists, it must not disable updates.
UPD-02.fixHint: A missing key is OK (no blocking policy). GPO: Configure Automatic Updates = 4.

UPD-03.title: UAC virtualization for files/registry
UPD-03.description: Legacy apps are virtualized per-user instead of writing system-wide.
UPD-03.fixHint: Default is 1. Only touch for compatibility issues.

UPD-04.title: Latest quality update max. 45 days old
UPD-04.description: The newest hotfix must not be older than 45 days (guideline: Patch Tuesday + buffer).
UPD-04.fixHint: Settings > Windows Update > Update history. Target: max. 30 days behind Patch Tuesday.

UPD-05.title: No pending update restart
UPD-05.description: No restart is pending to finalize updates.
UPD-05.fixHint: Perform the pending restart so updates (especially kernel) take effect.

AUD-01.title: PowerShell Script Block Logging enabled
AUD-01.description: Executed script blocks are logged (important for forensics).
AUD-01.fixHint: GPO: Administrative Templates > Windows Components > PowerShell > Script block logging.

AUD-02.title: Logon auditing: success + failure
AUD-02.description: Subcategory 'Logon' must audit success and failure (GUID match, language-independent).

AUD-03.title: Audit: capture logoffs
AUD-03.description: Subcategory 'Logoff' should at least log success (GUID match, language-independent).

AUD-04.title: Audit: privilege use (Sensitive Privilege Use)
AUD-04.description: Detects abuse of sensitive rights (e.g. Debug, Backup). GUID match, language-independent.

AUD-05.title: Security event log size >= 64 MB
AUD-05.description: Logs that are too small get overwritten too quickly.
AUD-05.fixHint: GPO: set Security event log size to 196608 KB or more.

SYS-01.title: AutoPlay/AutoRun disabled
SYS-01.description: No automatic execution from removable media.
SYS-01.fixHint: GPO: Turn off AutoPlay = All drives.

SYS-02.title: Prevent anonymous SAM enumeration
SYS-02.fixHint: GPO Security Options > Network access: Do not allow anonymous enumeration of SAM accounts.

SYS-03.title: Restrict anonymous access (RestrictAnonymous)
SYS-03.description: No anonymous connections with SID/name resolution.
SYS-03.fixHint: GPO: Network access: Do not allow anonymous SID/Name translation.

SYS-04.title: RDP with Network Level Authentication
SYS-04.description: If RDP is enabled, NLA must be enforced. If RDP is disabled, the check counts as passed (defense in depth).
SYS-04.fixHint: Either disable RDP (fDenyTSConnections=1) or enforce NLA (UserAuthentication=1).

SYS-05.title: Windows Installer: AlwaysInstallElevated off
SYS-05.description: Prevents privilege escalation via MSI packages.
SYS-05.fixHint: A missing key is good (not configured = off). Explicitly set to Disabled via GPO.

SYS-06.title: Automatic admin logon disabled
SYS-06.fixHint: AutoAdminLogon=0. A missing value is also OK; if reported as open, verify manually.

EDGE-01.title: Edge SmartScreen enabled
EDGE-01.description: Protection against phishing/malware downloads in Edge.
EDGE-01.fixHint: GPO Edge: enforce Microsoft Defender SmartScreen. Without a policy, SmartScreen is active by default - cross-check in Edge under edge://settings/privacy.

EDGE-02.title: Edge Enhanced Security Mode
EDGE-02.description: Hardens JIT / browser protection (Balanced or Strict).
EDGE-02.fixHint: Edge > Settings > Privacy > set Enhanced Security mode to Balanced/Strict. (Deliberate judgment call, no auto-check.)

EDGE-03.title: Edge typosquatting protection (manual)
EDGE-03.description: Warns about look-alike domains. Policy status varies by version.
EDGE-03.fixHint: Import the Edge security baseline from the Security Compliance Toolkit. (Deliberate judgment call, no auto-check.)

EDGE-04.title: Edge automatic updates (manual)
EDGE-04.description: The Edge updater service should run automatically.

EDGE-05.title: Edge: block SmartScreen bypass for sites
EDGE-05.description: Users cannot bypass SmartScreen warnings for websites.
EDGE-05.fixHint: Edge policy: Prevent bypassing SmartScreen prompts for sites = Enabled.

EDGE-06.title: Edge: block SmartScreen bypass for files
EDGE-06.description: Users cannot bypass SmartScreen warnings for downloads.
EDGE-06.fixHint: Edge policy: Prevent bypassing SmartScreen prompts for files = Enabled.

ACCT-12.title: Password history: remember 24 predecessors

ACCT-13.title: Maximum password age 60 days

ACCT-14.title: Reversibly encrypted passwords off

ACCT-14.fixHint: Default is Disabled. If set: secpol.msc > Store passwords using reversible encryption = Disabled.

ACCT-15.title: Account lockout threshold: 5 bad attempts

ACCT-17.title: Counter reset after 15 minutes

L2A-03.fixHint: secpol.msc > Security Options > Interactive logon: Number of previous logons to cache = 10 or fewer. Domain only.

L2A-04.title: Machine account password change allowed
L2A-04.description: Resetting the machine account password must not be prevented.
L2A-04.fixHint: Default is 0 (allowed). Only relevant for domain-joined devices.

L2A-05.title: Advanced auditing: DPAPI activity
L2A-05.description: Protecting DPAPI secrets requires gapless auditing (success + failure).

L2A-06.title: Advanced auditing: RPC events
L2A-06.description: Audit RPC calls (success + failure) to detect lateral movement.
L2A-06.fixHint: auditpol /set /subcategory:'RPC Events' /success:enable /failure:enable (admin). Generates noticeable log volume.

L2A-09.title: Advanced auditing: directory service access
L2A-09.description: Audit directory service access (only meaningful on domain).

L2A-10.title: Advanced auditing: directory service changes
L2A-10.description: Audit directory service changes (only meaningful on domain).

L2A-11.title: Advanced auditing: Kerberos ticket operations
L2A-11.description: Audit Kerberos Service Ticket Operations (only meaningful on domain).

L2A-12.title: Advanced auditing: filtering platform connections (failure)
L2A-12.description: Audit blocked firewall connections (defense in depth for logging).

L2S-01.title: SMBv1 server disabled
L2S-01.description: The outdated SMBv1 server service must be disabled (server side).
L2S-01.fixHint: Remove the SMB1 server feature or SMB1=0 (DWORD). Client side see NET-04.

L2S-02.title: SMB signing enforced server-side
L2S-02.description: The SMB server must require packet signing (relay protection, server side).
L2S-02.fixHint: LanManServer RequireSecuritySignature=1 (DWORD). Client side see NET-05.

L2S-03.title: Insecure guest logon to SMB server off
L2S-03.description: No unencrypted guest logons to SMB shares (client protection).

L2S-04.title: Bluetooth radio disabled
L2S-04.description: Bluetooth must be off unless organizationally approved (radio attack surface).
L2S-04.fixHint: Per policy AllowBluetooth=0 - or documented exception with ISSO. Not applicable without Bluetooth hardware. If the key is missing and the device has no Bluetooth, count manually as N/A.

L2S-05.title: Solicited Remote Assistance prohibited
L2S-05.description: Solicited Remote Assistance must be disabled (helpdesk entry point).

L2S-06.title: Autorun default behavior blocked
L2S-06.description: Suppress Autorun commands generally (NoAutorun, beyond NoDriveTypeAutoRun).

L2S-07.title: Remote Desktop disabled
L2S-07.description: L2 hardening: RDP is fully disabled (NLA alone is not enough here).
L2S-07.fixHint: fDenyTSConnections=1. If you need RDP, stay on L1 (SYS-04 with NLA) - that is the L2 difference.

L2S-08.title: Print Spooler disabled
L2S-08.description: L2 hardening: spooler is off (PrintNightmare attack surface). Only without printing need.
L2S-08.fixHint: services.msc > Print Spooler = Disabled. With printing need, fall back to L1 judgment (SVC-02).

L2S-09.title: Bluetooth Audio Gateway disabled
L2S-09.description: Bluetooth service BTAGService is disabled (radio hardening).
L2S-09.fixHint: services.msc > Bluetooth Audio Gateway Service = Disabled. Automatically passed without Bluetooth hardware.

L2S-10.title: Bluetooth Support Service disabled
L2S-10.description: Bluetooth service Bthserv is disabled (radio hardening).
L2S-10.fixHint: services.msc > Bluetooth Support Service = Disabled. Automatically passed without Bluetooth hardware.

L2S-11.title: Recall snapshots disabled
L2S-11.description: Windows Recall must not store snapshots (screenshot history, Copilot+ devices).

L2S-12.title: Location access off by policy
L2S-12.description: Windows location is disabled by policy.

PS-01.title: PowerShell transcription enabled
PS-01.description: Session transcripts are logged (forensics, complement to Script Block Logging).

PS-02.title: PowerShell module logging enabled
PS-02.description: Module load events are logged (detecting malicious modules).

OFF-01.title: Excel: all macros disabled without notification
OFF-01.description: VBA macros in Excel are fully blocked (VBAWarnings=4). Not applicable without Office.
OFF-01.fixHint: GPO/Office policy: Excel > Security > VBA macro notification settings = Disable all without notification.

OFF-02.title: Word: all macros disabled without notification
OFF-02.description: VBA macros in Word are fully blocked (VBAWarnings=4). Not applicable without Office.
OFF-02.fixHint: GPO/Office policy: Word > Security > VBA macro notification settings = Disable all without notification.

OFF-03.title: PowerPoint: all macros disabled without notification
OFF-03.description: VBA macros in PowerPoint are fully blocked (VBAWarnings=4). Not applicable without Office.
OFF-03.fixHint: GPO/Office policy: PowerPoint > Security > VBA macro notification settings = Disable all without notification.

OFF-04.title: Access: all macros disabled without notification
OFF-04.description: VBA macros in Access are fully blocked (VBAWarnings=4). Not applicable without Office.
OFF-04.fixHint: GPO/Office policy: Access > Security > VBA macro notification settings = Disable all without notification.

OFF-05.title: Excel: block internet macros
OFF-05.description: Macros in files from the internet are blocked in Excel. Not applicable without Office.
OFF-05.fixHint: GPO: Excel > Block macros from running in Office files from the Internet = Enabled.

OFF-06.title: Word: block internet macros
OFF-06.description: Macros in files from the internet are blocked in Word. Not applicable without Office.
OFF-06.fixHint: GPO: Word > Block macros from running in Office files from the Internet = Enabled.

OFF-07.title: PowerPoint: block internet macros
OFF-07.description: Macros in files from the internet are blocked in PowerPoint. Not applicable without Office.
OFF-07.fixHint: GPO: PowerPoint > Block macros from running in Office files from the Internet = Enabled.

OFF-08.title: Access: block internet macros
OFF-08.description: Macros in files from the internet are blocked in Access. Not applicable without Office.
OFF-08.fixHint: GPO: Access > Block macros from running in Office files from the Internet = Enabled.

TLS-01.title: .NET: strong cryptography enforced (64-bit)
TLS-01.description: .NET Framework uses strong TLS cryptography (SchUseStrongCrypto). Secure by default since 4.6.
TLS-01.fixHint: Set SchUseStrongCrypto=1 (DWORD) explicitly. A missing value = secure default since .NET 4.6.

TLS-02.title: .NET: strong cryptography enforced (32-bit)
TLS-02.fixHint: Set SchUseStrongCrypto=1 (DWORD) explicitly in the WoW64 branch.

TLS-03.title: .NET: system default TLS (64-bit)
TLS-03.description: .NET follows OS TLS defaults instead of its own.

TLS-04.title: .NET: system default TLS (32-bit)
TLS-04.fixHint: Set SystemDefaultTlsVersions=1 (DWORD) explicitly in the WoW64 branch.

NTLM-01.title: Incoming NTLM traffic is audited
NTLM-01.description: Incoming NTLM authentication is logged (at least domain accounts).
NTLM-01.fixHint: secpol.msc > Network security: Audit incoming NTLM traffic = Enable auditing for domain accounts (1) or higher.
NTLM-01.note: As of 25H2, Windows additionally logs NTLM to the Operational log (channel Microsoft-Windows-NTLM/Operational).

NTLM-02.title: Outgoing NTLM traffic audited or blocked
NTLM-02.description: Outgoing NTLM traffic is at least 'Audit all' (1), better 'Deny all' (2).
NTLM-02.fixHint: secpol.msc > Network security: outgoing NTLM traffic = Audit all (1) or Deny all (2, test first).
NTLM-02.note: As of 25H2, Windows additionally logs NTLM to the Operational log (channel Microsoft-Windows-NTLM/Operational).

LAP-01.title: Local admin password rotated (max. 60 days)
LAP-01.description: Built-in admin account (SID 500): disabled or password at most 60 days old - e.g. via Windows LAPS.
LAP-01.fixHint: Set up Windows LAPS (local admin password management) or disable the account.

NTP-01.title: Windows Time service running
NTP-01.description: The W32Time service is active (Kerberos needs max. 5 min. clock skew).

NTP-02.title: Time sync via NTP (stand-alone)
NTP-02.description: Stand-alone devices sync via NTP (no domain mode).
NTP-02.fixHint: W32Time\Parameters\Type = NTP (stand-alone). Domain uses NT5DS (Enterprise view).

NTP-03.title: Time sync via domain hierarchy (Enterprise)
NTP-03.description: Domain devices sync via NT5DS (domain hierarchy).

WDAC-01.title: Application allowlisting active (WDAC or AppLocker)
WDAC-01.description: Deny-by-default for executable software via WDAC policy or AppLocker rules. Cannot pass without an approval concept.
WDAC-01.fixHint: Introduce a WDAC policy (also possible on Pro) or AppLocker rules (Enterprise) with documented approval.

SO-01.title: Logon notice text configured
SO-01.description: Legal notice before logon (title and text set).
SO-01.fixHint: secpol.msc > Security Options > Interactive logon: message text/title for logon attempts.

SO-02.title: Last username not displayed
SO-02.description: The logon screen does not show the last logged-on user.
SO-02.fixHint: secpol.msc > Interactive logon: Do not display last user name = Enabled.

SVC-04.title: SSDP Discovery disabled
SVC-04.description: The SSDP Discovery service (UPnP discovery) is disabled.
SVC-04.fixHint: services.msc > SSDP Discovery = Disabled. Harmless without UPnP need.

SVC-05.title: UPnP Device Host disabled
SVC-05.description: The UPnP Device Host service is disabled.

GPO-01.title: Domain GPOs are applied
GPO-01.description: The device receives policy from domain GPOs (Enterprise context only, informational).
GPO-01.fixHint: Only relevant for domain-joined devices (gpresult /R to verify).

CERT-01.title: No expired root certificates
CERT-01.description: The machine root store contains no expired certificates.
CERT-01.fixHint: Remove expired roots (certlm.msc > Trusted Root Certification Authorities).

DEF-07.title: Defender antimalware service active
DEF-07.description: The antimalware service (AMService) is running (effective status).
DEF-07.fixHint: Check Windows Security > Virus & threat protection; a third-party AV may be the reason.

DEF-08.title: Defender antivirus engine active
DEF-08.description: The antivirus engine is enabled (effective status).
DEF-08.fixHint: Check Windows Security > Virus & threat protection.

DEF-09.title: Defender network protection engine active
DEF-09.description: Network Inspection System (NIS) is running (effective status).
DEF-09.fixHint: Check Windows Security > Firewall & network protection or Defender policy.

FW-D1.title: No legacy service shares (Telnet/TFTP/rsh)
FW-D1.description: No enabled inbound allow rules for outdated plaintext services (name-based heuristic).
FW-D1.fixHint: wf.msc > Inbound Rules: disable or delete legacy rules (Telnet/TFTP/rsh).

FW-D2.title: Review Edge Traversal exceptions
FW-D2.description: Number of enabled allow rules with Edge Traversal (Teredo tunnel) - should be 0, review list.
FW-D2.fixHint: wf.msc > Inbound Rules: set Edge Traversal to Block/Defer unless justifiably needed.

SHR-01.title: No share with Everyone full access
SHR-01.description: No (non-administrative) share grants Everyone/Guests full access.
SHR-01.fixHint: fsmgmt.msc > Shares: remove Everyone full access (requires admin to verify).

SHR-02.title: No unexpected hidden shares
SHR-02.description: Besides C$, ADMIN$, IPC$ and print$ there are no hidden shares.
SHR-02.fixHint: fsmgmt.msc > remove unexpected $-shares (requires admin to verify).
